item.description: Cadillac’s debut race in Formula 1 at this weekend’s Australian Grand Prix is “just the beginning” of its journey, says the team’s CEO Dan Towriss.

item.title: How NASCAR expedited the process to get Snider into the No. 48 at COTA
item.description: Myatt Snider was approved on the fly Sunday to be allowed to jump in the No. 48 for Hendrick Motorsports and finish the Cup Series race at Circuit of The Americas in relief of Alex Bowman.

item.title: Aston Martin likely to run limited laps in Australian GP out of concern for driver welfare
item.description: Aston Martin says it is likely to limited the number of laps it runs in the Australian Grand Prix due to vibrations creating a risk of permanent nerve damage for its drivers.
